sampling_policies: frozen production policies, no test-based retuning
statistics: mean over case-averaged matched sampling-seed rAUEC ratios within each training run, then mean and sample SD over three independent training runs; absolute errors and sampling variability separately
darcy_scope: new validation-selected weights; inherited historical policy choices are not claimed to be sealed-test-selected

policy_selection_history.elasticity: Original budget10 development-selected policies; final test IDs 1600..1799.
policy_selection_history.pipe: Frozen parameters were historically calibrated on the first 50 of the current 200 test cases; no retuning in this study.
policy_selection_history.darcy: Frozen historical test-informed policies; new model and head checkpoints use a disjoint validation cohort.

elasticity_head_execution: All three complete 128-to-4-to-1 heads use FP32 CPU feature extraction and 200-epoch CPU training; selected before the first head optimizer step. Backbones and final evaluation use GPU.
